questions.question:
**From the given options, identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Nowadays spectacles are costly than they used to be.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**costly than**____.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d75abffb1d7f21a0cb21fc40907655c03b3b6a401e1a3b03d94c609e009dc398.png] 

 
• In the sentence, 'costly than' is incorrect. 
 
• Here, a **comparison** is made between the new spectacles and old. 
 
• Whenever there is a comparison, we must use a comparative degree of the adjective. 
 
• Here, '**costlier**' is the comparative degree of the word '**costly**'. 
 
• So, 'costly than is the correct solution. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/706130912380410577fa60a9a869a451a8c2ada2e0a5d65da911dcd5d9f65175.png] 

 
• In error-type questions, we first look for grammatical errors if any and then vocabulary based errors.
 
• We look at the tense of the whole sentence and see if all the verbs are in the correct tense. 

**So the correct sentence is** - *Nowadays spectacles are **costlier** than they used to be.*

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Fragile**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given words are: 'Something which gets broken easily'.
 
• In option 1, the word 'Fragile' means (of an object) easily broken or damaged.__
 
• So, 'Fragile' is the word which means the same as the group of words given.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let us know the meanings of other given words:
 
 
• **Feeble - **physically weak, as from age or sickness; frail.
 
• **Soft - **easy to mould, cut, compress, or fold; not hard or firm to the touch.
 
• **Weak - **lacking the power to perform physically demanding tasks; having little physical strength or energy.
